hook: Two states sue over Grok deepfakes

beats.say: The attorneys general of Oregon and Virginia are suing several of Elon Musk's companies over Grok's weak safeguards against sexualized imagery of real people, including children.
Both suits name SpaceX and X Corp, and they follow earlier lawsuits from the city of Baltimore and teens in Tennessee.
Virginia filed in Richmond's circuit court, Oregon in Multnomah County, each hiring the same private firm to help litigate.
